title: Fix dev-mode memory blow-up from ImageData props
description: React 19.2 dev-mode Components profiler diffs old/new props recursively (addObjectDiffToProperties), enumerating up to 3 levels deep. Viewer/StepPanel receive raw ImageData (rectified.image, outline.mask, photo.image) as props, causing tens of millions of enumerated entries per render, heap jumping from 84MB to 2.2GB, and a DataCloneError OOM crash under npm run dev. Fix: wrap large buffers in an opaque Box<T> class (private field, nothing enumerable) before passing as props.
close_reason: Wrapped ImageData/large-polygon props (photo, rectified, outline, exportResult, effectivePolygon) in src/lib/box.ts's opaque Box<T> before passing to Viewer/StepPanel, keeping React 19.2 dev profiler's prop-diff enumeration off the pixel buffers.
